conventions.paradigm: ADR-007: decisions pure in claim-domain; adapters and cli verbs do I/O only.
conventions.test_paradigm: Acceptance: example-based subprocess. Pure core: proptest against the CORE oracles. Adapters: real DuckDB / real HTTP adapter against FakeGithubAccounts, never mocked.
conventions.scenario_fns: `<cargo test target>::<fn>` (identity_link = tests/acceptance/identity_link.rs, identity_link_core = tests/acceptance/identity_link_core.rs), in activation order.
conventions.test_edit_allow_list: Test-file edits limited to: removing the #[ignore] of a named scenario_fn; replacing the named sut_* body with ONE real call plus view mapping (DD-GDL-16). Forbidden: assertions, oracles, strategies, universe slots, helpers, test names. The GREEN diff must match. Carve-out (U-12, review N3): crafter-owned tests in their owning crates (adapter contract tests such as crates/adapter-github/tests/github_profile_contract.rs, xtask check-arch rule tests, claim-domain unit/property tests) may be added; tests/acceptance stays under this allow-list. Review-domain unit/property tests (crates/review-domain/src) are crafter-owned under the same carve-out (slice-3 re-review C-8). Slice-3 exception 03-03 only (C-1): the two properties an_account_github_did_not_name_is_never_proven and only_github_username_shaped_text_is_a_login MOVE unchanged in name and assertions from review-domain ownership.rs to claim-domain identity_link.rs, and the oracle of the_capability_is_minted_only_for_a_verified_unchanged_account is replaced by a literal bio-token oracle (F-14); the commit message records old and new assertions and the assertion count does not decrease. tests/acceptance/support/* stays DISTILL-owned: a crafter never edits it; a needed support change stops the step and goes to the acceptance designer (C-5).
conventions.test_runs: Scoped targets only, never the workspace. libtest runs tests matching ANY positional filter (library/test/src/cli.rs), so `-- f1 f2` is used.
conventions.check_arch: `cargo xtask check-arch` (.cargo/config.toml alias) + `cargo test -p xtask`; each new rule ships a synthetic-violation test.
conventions.link_predicate_api: Q-RM-5: claim_domain::identity_link exposes the link predicate through its API (e.g. link_predicate()); readers select candidate rows with it; project() decides.
